title: Free AI-generated game asset cleanup tools (splitting sheets, remove background, snap to color palette, scale, hue shift, rename, etc.)
author: Rsloth

comments.author: inmyhimberlands
comments.body: You dropping a link or nah

replies.author: Significant_Tell407
replies.body: Do you handle pixel resolution also? My biggest issue has been generating assets that need to be manually downscaled in Asperite but that causes significant image degrading.

replies.author: Rsloth
replies.body:
The first example in the video is an example of downscaling. The sheet is a 1024x1024 asset which AI generates a standard size.

So each tile in this is 256x256 asset.

It gets output (downscaled) into 64x64 1px brush artboards in the video.

But it could also get output to 128x128 2px brush artboards

or 256x256 4px brush artboards

replies.author: Significant_Tell407
replies.body: Awesome thanks. I'll definitely check it out

comments.author: KronchyBitz

replies.author: Rsloth
